record.title: CEREBRAL BABESIOSIS DUE TO BABESIA GIBSONI IN A DOG - A CASE REPORT
record.journal: DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals)
record.abstract: A case of cerebral babesiosis due to B.gibsoni in a dog charecterised by depression, weakness, ataxia, seizures and anorexia was described. It was successfully treated with a single dose of diminazene aceturate @7.5 mg/ kg BW. The report stresses the need for including cerebral babesiosis in the differential diagnosis of neurological disorders in dogs

screening.species: B. gibsoni (reported; confirmation method not stated)
screening.rationale: Case report of cerebral babesiosis with seizures and ataxia. It describes a distinct neurological syndrome.
